questions.question: Who has more wickets — Masabata Klaas or Raessa van der Westhuizen? (T20.)
questions.explanation: Masabata Klaas: 49 — Raessa van der Westhuizen: 8.

questions.question: This database's Partnership_By_Wicket records include a 151-run 7th-wicket stand from October 2024, involving Fay Cowling and one other player. That other player is a two-time World Championship medallist and an Olympic silver medallist. In which sport?
questions.explanation: That's Sunette Viljoen-Louw, an Olympic silver medallist (Rio 2016) and two-time World Championship medallist in javelin, who returned to domestic cricket over 20 years after her only Test cap.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Wicketkeeping Dismissals' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Mieke de Ridder holds it, with a total of 36.

questions.question: At which ground did Alacia Giles record their career-best bowling figures (2-6, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Tuskers on 2019/11/03.
